sentences.text: This section defines how the Caldera Incident Command Portal supports coordinated air and ground operations after an incident enters a managed response posture.
When the Caldera Incident Command Portal shows the Airspace Restricted State, aircraft tasking is treated as conditional until the Air Attack Supervisor confirms the active operating window.
The Duty Detection Officer records the restriction basis in the Caldera Incident Command Portal so later decisions can be traced to the operational condition in effect at the time.
The Air Attack Supervisor is responsible for deconflicting fixed-wing, rotary-wing, and uncrewed routes before the Drone Pilot Operator launches from the Horizon Ridge Drone Dock.
The Drone Tasking Service shall not issue a launch task that conflicts with an active aviation lane maintained by the Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console.
The Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console provides the aviation status view used by the Tanker Base Manager to sequence retardant aircraft availability.
The Tanker Base Manager coordinates pump readiness for the East Retardant Loading Pump and the West Retardant Loading Pump before confirming that a tanker can accept an assignment.
The VHF Radio Gateway Repeater is also known as Badger for voice traffic when a short call sign is needed during congested incident radio operations.
The VHF Radio Gateway Repeater bridges command, air-to-ground, and county liaison talk paths when direct radio coverage is degraded by terrain.
Radio bridging shall preserve the original speaker identity when the source channel provides it, because aviation supervisors use that identity to validate tasking and hazard reports.
If a bridge path fails, the Caldera Incident Command Portal marks the affected radio route as impaired and requires manual acknowledgement by the Duty Detection Officer.
Orion must verify that the impaired route has an alternate contact method before any new aviation coordination message is accepted.
The County Emergency Liaison is the primary contact for county dispatch, road control, evacuation support, and local public safety notifications.
The County Emergency Liaison sends the Drone Corridor Permit after local jurisdiction review is complete.
County liaison procedures require that jurisdictional constraints be entered in the Caldera Incident Command Portal before the Drone Pilot Operator receives a route briefing.

Temporary flight restrictions are requested through the established incident aviation chain and are represented internally by the Airspace Restricted State only after acceptance by the responsible authority.
The Air Attack Supervisor reviews each temporary restriction against current fire perimeter intelligence from the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine before approving a release of air assets.
The MesoWest Weather Fusion Node supplies wind and visibility context used by aviation supervisors during route selection and holding-area planning.
The North Lookout Camera Mast and the South Lookout Camera Mast provide observation context that helps the Air Attack Supervisor assess whether smoke columns may reduce route visibility.
The South Lookout Camera Mast produces the Camera Cleaning Log as part of its maintenance reporting.
The Smoke Classifier Module may be temporarily down-weighted by the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine when observation quality is suspected to be degraded.
The Helitack Crew Leader uses the Crewline Mobile Tablet to acknowledge air-to-ground instructions and report whether crews are inside any planned drop or reconnaissance area.
The Caldera Incident Command Portal displays crew acknowledgements beside aviation tasks so the Air Attack Supervisor can verify that ground resources are clear before authorizing flight activity.
If the Confirmed Ignition State is active and airspace approval is delayed, the system keeps suppression planning visible while preventing premature aircraft dispatch.
Coordination records are retained with timestamps, participant identities, and radio path status so post-incident review can reconstruct both aviation decisions and interagency notifications.
